children: The Trust’s net assets from operations fell year over year as a smaller unrealized gain on gold and lower realized gains outweighed an increase in creations. Gold’s price per ounce rose 3.73% during the quarter, while outstanding Shares increased after creations exceeded redemptions.
: The Trust held 1,716,361.6 ounces of gold at September 30, 2026, up from 1,638,228.9 ounces a year earlier.
: The price per ounce rose 3.73% from $4,026.05 at June 30, 2026 to $4,176.30 at September 30, 2026.
: 5,700,000 Shares were created and 1,300,000 Shares were redeemed during the quarter.
: The Sponsor’s Fee was $3,098,084 for the quarter, or 0.17% of the Trust’s ANAV on an annualized basis.
